notes: Page 80: continues day 20 (Abba John Hagir / Abba Baymoy), no arke, no day opener. First Ge'ez and Amharic lines continue p79 ¶፬ (joined with a space after the trailing ፡). Ge'ez: ዕፅብት (scan; maybe ዕፁብ), ነሥአ (scan ነሥአ/ነሥኦ ambiguous), አስተርእዮ x2 kept as scanned, ዘበጦ, ወለለጽባሑ, እኅድር, ወቅዱሰኒ, ወእቱሰ kept from scan.
